rules.name: File format
rules.why: Shopify accepts GLB and USDZ 3D files.

rules.name: File size
rules.why: Small files load fast in the store and in AR.
rules.quote: If you upload a 3D model file that exceeds 15 MB, then your file is automatically optimized.

rules.name: One mesh
rules.why: One object keeps the model simple to load and to check.
rules.quote: All objects have been combined into one object.

rules.name: One material
rules.why: One material means fewer draw calls and a smaller file.
rules.quote: There is only one material assigned to the model, unless otherwise necessary.

rules.name: Real-world size
rules.why: AR shows the product at its true size, so the model must match it.
rules.quote: The model is built to real-world scale.

rules.name: Transforms applied
rules.why: Unapplied rotation or scale can turn or stretch the model in the store.

rules.name: Origin at the base
rules.why: The product must stand on the floor, centred, when shown in AR.
rules.quote: The base of the model has been placed at the origin of the grid.

rules.name: Texture size
rules.why: Textures over 2048 px make the file heavy without a visible gain.
rules.quote: For mobile web, texture files shouldn't be larger than 2048 x 2048 px.

rules.name: Texture format
rules.why: JPG keeps colour maps small; PNG is only needed for transparency.
rules.quote: Textures should be optimized JPG files, if possible.

rules.name: PBR material
rules.why: Procedural nodes don't export; only image textures reach the store.
rules.quote: Textures are exported using a physically-based rendering (PBR) workflow.

rules.name: Packed ORM texture
rules.why: Occlusion, roughness and metalness in one image saves file size.
rules.quote: a single map with occlusion, roughness, and metalness mapped to the red, green, and blue channels respectively

rules.name: One UV map
rules.why: Extra UV maps add weight and can confuse the exporter.

rules.name: UVs inside 0–1
rules.why: UVs outside the square repeat or cut the texture.
rules.quote: All the UV shells are positioned in the 1:1 space.

rules.name: No overlapping UVs
rules.why: Overlapping UVs share pixels and can break baked detail.
rules.quote: None of the UV shells overlap.

rules.name: No n-gons
rules.why: Faces with more than 4 sides can render badly once triangulated.
rules.quote: The mesh is quadrangulated, meaning it uses four-sided geometry.

rules.name: Clean edges
rules.why: Open or tangled edges show as holes or dark seams.
rules.quote: Make sure that all edges are sealed and that points have been connected.

rules.name: Normals face outward
rules.why: Inverted normals make faces look missing or black.

rules.name: No zero-area faces
rules.why: Faces with no area cause shading errors.

rules.name: Edges bevelled
rules.why: Sharp edges look fake in close-up AR views.
rules.quote: Product edges are beveled to smooth transitions:

rules.name: UVs unwrapped by hand with natural seams
rules.why: Seams in hidden places keep textures clean.

rules.name: No visible Z-fighting
rules.why: Faces on top of each other flicker in the viewer.
rules.quote: Z-fighting (duplicate polygons in the same place)

rules.name: Colours match the product photos
rules.why: Buyers compare the model with your photos.
rules.quote: Materials assigned to the geometry match the product reference photos.
